source: Claude, d'après l'arbre du dépôt et le README
explication_en: The AirPlayService service starts the native UxPlay library via NativeBridge over JNI. The RAOP callbacks come back up into Kotlin, then feed the MediaCodec video pipeline and the audio rendering.
